title: Solving Sparsity Constrained PCA, Regression, and QCQP via the Spartrahedron
summary: Sparsity is a fundamental modeling principle in statistics, signal processing, and data science. However, optimization with sparsity constraints is notoriously difficult. We introduce a new convex relaxation framework for {sparse quadratically constrained quadratic programs} (QCQPs), a class that subsumes sparse regression, sparse principal component analysis (PCA), and related problems. Our approach is based on a novel convex cone, the spartrahedron, which exactly characterizes sparsity at the matrix level.
